speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I was cold, as ordered. I did not gather a second opinion. I gathered a numb ear, which I am returning to you unused.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it unused. The three agree. You have had your once. The next time you say it, it will be on the day, to a door, and the paper will still be ahead of your mouth.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: The weight stays. I will be here when you are painted, and I will not be here to show them again. A shown thing has been shown.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Go and eat. The afternoon is a different bill, and the bill is not a secret from the post, whatever you refuse to sew into a coat. Be back before the stair is a quarrel.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know the hour. I am going by the ordinary road. If I am late it will be a cart, not a fourth look at a cue I have already agreed to.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Shall I forget the old line between now and two, or only not say it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not forget it. Forgetting is how it jumps out. Leave it in your head, where you put it, and spend your mouth on your dinner.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: I will lock nothing. The tiring-house is not a strong room. The weight is the lock, and the company knows not to tidy a weight off a wet decision.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we are done. Eightpence is in. The stitch is not. Paint at two. Will, go home while home is still serving dinner.
